title: Beeswax Tin (Tinymight)
description:
Beeswax Tin
This Beeswax is direct from Tinymight which is sourced out of Finland. This is used to treat the wood section on your tinymight. This can also be used on other wood items. Using this product not only refreshes the look of wood but also protects it.
Included
1 x Beeswax Tin (Approximately 10ml)
